title: South Korea Arrests Shincheonji Church Leader Lee Man-hee for Alleged Political Interference
detail: South Korean authorities have arrested Lee Man-hee, leader of the Shincheonji Church of Jesus, on allegations of meddling in politics. Lee, who founded the controversial religious group in 1984, has previously been a high-profile figure in South Korean society. The arrest marks a significant development as authorities investigate the church's alleged political activities and interference.

media.caption: Shincheonji Church leader Lee Man-hee arrested for alleged political interference
